caption: : Eval PPL. under different Shared Sub-Dim ratio settings.

annotations.annotation: The line plot illustrates a comparison of evaluation perplexity (PPL) values for two models as a function of shared sub-dimensions relative to total sub-dimensions. The x-axis is labeled "Shared Sub-Dims / Total Sub-Dims" with a linear scale ranging from 0/4 to 4/4, and the tick labels are evenly spaced at intervals of 1/4. The y-axis is labeled "Eval PPL" with a linear scale ranging from 10.0 to 12.5, with tick labels at every 0.5 unit interval. There are two lines in the plot. The first line is red with a dashed style representing the "Transformer" model, remaining constant across the x-axis at a y-value of approximately 11.6. The second line is blue with a solid style and square markers representing the "MoHD" model. It starts at approximately 11.1 at 0/4 on the x-axis, decreases to a minimum at around 10.25 at 3/4, and then increases back to approximately 10.75 at 4/4. A legend is provided at the top right corner of the plot.
